assessment.correctness: Passed on all three candidate platforms at the recorded source; HTML net8/net10 and PDF net10 correctness suites, conditional installed-font lanes, and both packed consumers are green.
assessment.outputContracts: Every pair retains the same ordered 76 output contracts. PNG/SVG output hashes are identical between candidate and prior-source control; only 4 Windows /2 Linux /2 macOS PDF hashes change, reducing candidate output totals on every platform. All candidate cold/warm fingerprints are identical within their host.
assessment.candidatePerformanceQualification: Linux passes all configured ceilings. Windows and macOS fail elapsed-time ceilings only. Allocation, process-tree peak memory, output size, determinism and cancellation pass for every candidate.
assessment.priorSourceControl: Windows and macOS reproduce cold/warm timing failures; Windows also reproduces 3,008,293 deterministic output bytes against 3,000,000. Linux control fails only cold timing (12,090.1022 ms versus 12,000).
assessment.regressionConclusion: This run does not establish a new output-contract, deterministic artifact-size, allocation, peak-memory or cancellation defect. It records unresolved candidate Windows/macOS performance acceptance, with the same failure class present in control; it does not prove the host is solely responsible or that candidate timing cannot regress.
assessment.timingInferenceBoundary: One sequential candidate-then-control pair per host, one reported cold iteration and three warmed iterations per process. No rotated order, independent repeated batches, per-case timing or CPU/power-domain evidence in these reports. Candidate macOS cold timing is 19,073.371 ms versus control 14,794.5962 ms; retain this observed difference without attributing it to code.
assessment.canonicalCodeBug: No new canonical-owner code defect is established by these reports. The historical control artifact-size excess is absent in the candidate. Do not raise ceilings or weaken gates to turn the run green.
assessment.recommendedNextBoundedEvidence: Keep failed optional timing qualification visible. If performance acceptance must be closed, gather a controlled profile and repeated equivalent corpus comparison with host/CPU metadata and rotated order through the canonical PowerForge benchmarking owner; keep deterministic output and API resource-limit proof separate.
assessment.conditionalFontEvidenceLimit: InstalledMathFontRetainsOperationBoundsAndCancellationWhenAvailable has an early return when an installed math face cannot be added. Its reported 1/1 success does not independently prove the installed math path ran; the receipt has no chosen math-font identity. Report these checks as conditional.
assessment.currentHeadBoundary: Production owner trees at fe137, 044477 and local committed 0145318 match. The active uncommitted CSS/table/border changes remain outside this run and require their own exact-candidate proof.
